new_learnings.text: 赤峰黄金 entered on Day 1 post-resumption bounce (+5-7%) after 跌停 on 3/23. This is a high-volatility entry in a stock undergoing control change + gold macro downtrend. The acquisition by 紫金矿业 at ~41.34 equivalent provides a theoretical floor, but gold's -17% crash from Jan highs creates strong headwinds. Monitor whether acquisition floor holds or gold macro dominates.
new_learnings.related_hypothesis: h016 (event-driven vs trend stocks need different rules)
new_learnings.mechanism: Acquisition provides price floor via implied takeout value, but commodity macro trend can overwhelm deal-driven support if gold continues to crash.

new_learnings.text: IV Rank 14.1% < 15% rule was violated on 赤峰黄金 entry — position should have been 3% not 6%. Low IV = complacent market = higher risk of vol expansion. This is especially dangerous for a stock that just came off a 跌停.
new_learnings.related_hypothesis: h019 (IV极低+短期涨幅已大=最差入场时机)
new_learnings.mechanism: Low IV means options market is pricing in calm. When vol expands from low levels, the move is often violent and directional. Oversized positions in low-IV environments amplify drawdowns.

new_learnings.text: 能源金属(锂电) is the true momentum leader — 碳酸锂 prices up 18 consecutive weeks, supply disruptions from overseas mines, oil price driving EV demand narrative. This is a PERSISTENT sector trend, not a one-day spike. Should prioritize enriching 锂电 candidates (华盛锂电, 新宙邦, 中伟新材, 嘉元科技) for next session.
new_learnings.related_hypothesis: h007 (行业供需拐点催化>个股亮点数量)
new_learnings.mechanism: Supply disruption + demand acceleration = pricing power. Lithium carbonate 18-week rally is a structural supply-demand shift, not speculation. Stocks in this chain should have persistent momentum.

new_learnings.text: 创新药 sector has a clear, fresh, multi-catalyst setup: (1) AACR 2026 conference upcoming, (2) 恒瑞医药 2025 revenue guidance +30%, (3) policy upgrade for biomedical industry strategic positioning, (4) BD transaction validation of domestic innovation assets. This is an 'ongoing' catalyst with institutional flow (80亿+ main force net inflow on 3/27). Should enrich 荣昌生物, 国邦医药 for next session.
new_learnings.mechanism: Conference catalysts create a defined window of attention and flow. Policy upgrade provides structural support. BD transactions validate asset value globally.
